coverage.name: Elbert County
limitations: The county's only posted 2026 sample ballot ("2026 SAMPLE BALLOT.pdf", one two-page style, PDF modified 2026-09-30) is image-only: it was produced by Microsoft Print to PDF and its only text layer is the "SAMPLE BALLOT" watermark. Under the scanned-PDF rule no conclusion is drawn from it (checked 2026-10-10).

The Elections page posts no TABOR notice, ballot-content certification or participating-entities list. Its other 2026 General documents are the logic and accuracy test notice, voter instructions and the state Ballot Blue Book (checked 2026-10-10).

Leads only, for owner review: the rendered pages show no Elbert County question. The local ballot issues shown are Douglas County School District RE-1 Ballot Issue 5A and Elbert Fire Protection District Ballot Issue 7B. A text-readable ballot or the TABOR notice is needed to close this row.

On 2026-09-26 the town site was recorded as stating that the November ballot would carry the Mayor and Trustee seats. On 2026-10-10 the town Election page still described the November 5, 2024 General Election, linked the 2024 sample ballot, and said "Regular Town elections are coordinated with the County and held every 2 years during even-numbered years."

The town Agendas and Minutes page lists nothing after June 2025, and the home page posts no 2026 election notice (checked 2026-10-10). The town site has no 2026 election content, so under the #2072 rule the row stays open.

coverage.name: Simla (town)
limitations: The county's only posted 2026 sample ballot ("2026 SAMPLE BALLOT.pdf", one two-page style, PDF modified 2026-09-30) is image-only: it was produced by Microsoft Print to PDF and its only text layer is the "SAMPLE BALLOT" watermark. Under the scanned-PDF rule no conclusion is drawn from it (checked 2026-10-10). Read for leads only, it has no Town of Simla section. It is a single style, and no official source says which areas it covers.

The town Voting & Elections page states: "The Town of Simla holds a regular municipal election on the first Tuesday of April in every even-numbered year." It adds: "From time to time, the Town may participate in coordinated elections held by Elbert County." Participation in the November election could not be confirmed without a county list.

The town Public Notices page lists ordinances adopted through the August 11, 2026 board meeting (Ordinances 357 to 368); none refers a ballot question. With no county list and no text-readable style for the Simla area, the row stays open (checked 2026-10-10).
